premise.reportedComponent: Controller manager Deployment as shipped by deploy/helm/rbgs (chart) and config/manager + deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml (kustomize path)

premise.evidence: PR's own contract tests grafted verbatim onto base 1fc69f70 (== origin/main) all FAIL: no PDB on either install path, no TSC, no affinity knob. failurePolicy: Fail verified in deploy/kubectl/manifests.yaml; readiness probe (from #575) present on base so PDB Ready-counting is meaningful.
